results.title: North East town residents invited to comment on planning proposals - public notice
results.description: Residents are being invited to comment on four proposals affecting listed buildings and conservation areas in Middlesbrough, including plans for new advertising, roof repairs, an extension and garden landscaping.

results.description: The LRC welcomed the order but criticised the department for dragging the matter for three years before admitting unconstitutionality.

results.title: Residents near new station say enforcement must improve to stop parking ‘surge’
results.description: Cambridge residents living near the city’s latest railway station say enforcement must improve to stop a “surge” of parking.
